root_cause: GitHub App installation API quota exhausted during main-write provenance classifier; prior lookup performed up to three commit-association reads and two PR reads even when rate-limited. Run #39940563356 observed 5 attempted provider reads returning PROVIDER_PR_PROOF_UNVERIFIED. Then stateful-incident write called paginated open issues, got 403, jq error and terminal workflow failure. Immutable main sha 03bf825a6f4207df397f045ba0a3630faef34170 was independently verified as legitimate protected squash PR #4762, not proven direct-main bypass.
fix: Prefer a single GitHub exact PR-number record derived only as untrusted squash-message lookup hint; require provider verified merged_at, base main, numeric PR ID, exact head merge_commit_sha. If that does not independently verify, use bounded existing commit association. On GitHub primary or secondary rate-limit abort immediately without repeated reads or additional stateful issue API call; preserve terminal red UNKNOWN_MAIN_WRITE and immutable artifact. For non-limited genuine incidents keep existing canonical stateful-issue route.
prevention_rule: Never infer unauthorized production main write from a missing provider response; NEVER call a limited GitHub installation repeatedly or fan out a new issue write on a rate-limited API. Never mark success without exact independent PR provider association. On true unauthorized material direct main writes preserve fail-closed incident and required protections.

invariants: Trusted GitHub provider PR record validates merged_at, main base, exact immutable merge SHA
Forged commit suffix cannot itself prove authorization
429 or GitHub installation limit 403 triggers at most one provider call and zero issue mutations
Unknown authorization evidence remains RED and canonical evidence artifact persists
True direct material single-parent write with complete, negative provider evidence remains a RED security incident
Original Required, CodeQL, branch protection and all tenant release gates remain mandatory

promotion: Exact-head Required and CodeQL success; protected merge; independent main-write integrity workflow on future main commit; no unverified green or rate-limit bypass.
